misconfigurations.title: Developer stack traces are displayed to visitors
misconfigurations.recommendation: Disable debugdisplay on production sites and review the server-side error.

misconfigurations.title: Moodle data directory marker is reachable over HTTP

evidence.detail: Moodle file store marker is downloadable; individual uploaded files were not requested

misconfigurations.recommendation: Move dataroot outside the web root and verify uploaded files, sessions and caches are not public.

misconfigurations.title: Version control metadata is exposed
misconfigurations.recommendation: Deny access to dot directories (.git, .svn, .hg) in the web server configuration.

misconfigurations.title: Backup or editor copy of config.php is downloadable

evidence.detail: PHP configuration source exposed; settings (values redacted): dataroot, dbhost, dbname, dbpass, dbtype, dbuser, prefix, wwwroot

misconfigurations.recommendation: Remove exposed configuration copies, deny backup extensions, and rotate any live credentials they contain.

misconfigurations.title: Installer or upgrade confirmation form is publicly reachable
misconfigurations.recommendation: Complete installation/upgrade, configure an upgrade key and restrict administrative setup endpoints.

observations.title: Account self-registration form is offered
observations.recommendation: Review whether public account registration is intended; form visibility alone is not a vulnerability.

observations.title: Guest login option is offered

evidence.detail: login form offers a guest account; no guest session was created

observations.recommendation: Review guest access policy; a guest button does not establish access to private course content.

observations.title: Web services availability check succeeds

evidence.detail: public appsitecheck reports web services available; authentication was not attempted

observations.recommendation: Review whether web services are intended; availability alone does not establish an authentication weakness.

observations.title: Public development manifests or upgrade notes
observations.recommendation: Review deployment policy for public development files; their availability alone is not a vulnerability.
